pages.text: TYPE_TIME stands for the type TIME: a point in time.$(br2)A new TIME holds the start of 1970 (UTC). You can add or subtract milliseconds as an INTEGER. Two times subtracted give the difference in milliseconds.

Times can be compared with $(1)=$(), $(1)<$(), $(1)>$() and the others: the earlier time is the smaller one. $(1)⊕$() writes a TIME as ISO text in UTC with milliseconds, like $(1)2026-10-19T12:05:09.250Z$(). FORMAT of c0de/strings writes it in the time zone of the server.
Craft a type base and a clock together.
$(1)VARIABLE start TIME @2026-10-19T12:05:09Z$(br)VARIABLE later TIME$(br)ASSIGN later start + 60000 ;$()
